title: Telegram Desktop session and cache (Flatpak)
whyItMatters: The Flatpak build keeps the live Telegram session and media cache inside its sandbox folder, where a native-only check will not find it.
source: Flatpak sandbox permissions: per-app data lives in ~/.var/app/<app-id>/data; Telegram's Flathub id is org.telegram.desktop: https://docs.flatpak.org/en/latest/sandbox-permissions.html
notes: Same tdata contents as the native install, under the Flatpak data directory.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Telegram Desktop, use the export option in the advanced settings if you want a copy of your chats: the tdata session is not readable.
cleanup.signOut: In Telegram Desktop, open Settings, then the menu in the top right corner, and choose Log out, so this computer stops using the account.
steps: Quit Telegram Desktop from its tray icon.
Uninstall the Telegram Flatpak from the App Center or from your Flatpak tool.
Move the folder named in the plan to the Trash and empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Ends the session and deletes the local media cache and message database inside the sandbox. Chats stay in your Telegram account.
cleanup.source: Telegram, How do I log out? (Telegram FAQ): https://telegram.org/faq#q-how-do-i-log-out
